ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, with vertex B of $\triangle ABC$ as the center and the length of BA as the radius, an arc is drawn intersecting side BC at point D, and AD is connected. If $\angle B=50^\circ$ and $\angle C=36^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle DAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle B=50^\circ$ and $\angle C=36^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle BAC=180^\circ-(\angle B+\angle C)=180^\circ-(50^\circ+36^\circ)=94^\circ$,\\
since BA=BD,\\
thus $\angle BAD=\angle BDA$,\\
therefore $\angle BAD=\frac{1}{2}(180^\circ-\angle B)=\frac{1}{2}(180^\circ-50^\circ)=65^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle DAC=\angle BAC-\angle BAD=94^\circ-65^\circ=\boxed{29^\circ}$.
